genxml.title: RAD1 graphics head registers
genxml.doc: Registers of the PsiTech RAD1 PCI graphics board as the stock IRIX 6.5 kernel driver and the IO6 PROM textport use them. The board's chip is a TI TVP4020 (Permedia 2) or a 3Dlabs Permedia 2V, so every register here is a chip register: Region Zero (the 128 KiB register region) and the RAMDAC registers the chip holds behind its index ports. Names come from public X.Org and Linux drivers for those chips; the offsets are confirmed against the shipped objects. Grades here are the three the definition format allows: established covers what a public source or the shipped binaries state outright (the doc says which), inferred covers inferences and model approximations. The finer ratings are in devices/rad1/README.md.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_CONTROL
struct.doc: Cursor control: 64x64 size and the cursor mode. Software expectation.

struct.name: RD_COLOR_MODE
struct.doc: Colour mode: 8888 pixel format with GUI, RGB and true colour set at init.

struct.name: RD_MODE_CONTROL
struct.doc: Mode control. Written 0.

struct.name: RD_MISC_CONTROL
struct.doc: Misc control: 8-bit palette, sync polarities and sync on green.

struct.name: RD_PIXEL_CLOCK_C1
struct.doc: Pixel clock C, feedback (M).

struct.name: RD_PIXEL_CLOCK_C2
struct.doc: Pixel clock C, prescale (N).

struct.name: RD_PIXEL_CLOCK_C3
struct.doc: Pixel clock C, postscale (P) with the enable bit (bit 3). Written 0 first to stop the PLL.

struct.name: RD_PIXEL_CLOCK_STATUS
struct.doc: Pixel clock status; bit 4 is the lock flag.

struct.name: RD_MEMORY_CLOCK_1
struct.doc: Memory clock, feedback (M).

struct.name: RD_MEMORY_CLOCK_2
struct.doc: Memory clock, prescale (N).

struct.name: RD_MEMORY_CLOCK_3
struct.doc: Memory clock, postscale (P) with the enable bit. Written 6 first to stop the PLL.

struct.name: RD_MEMORY_CLOCK_STATUS
struct.doc: Memory clock status; bit 4 is the lock flag.

struct.name: RD_MISC_CONTROL_2V
struct.doc: Misc control: high colour resolution, direct colour and overlay set at init.

struct.name: RD_SYNC_CONTROL_2V
struct.doc: Sync control: horizontal and vertical polarity at the pin. Software expectation.

struct.name: RD_DAC_CONTROL_2V
struct.doc: DAC control: blank pedestal at init; the textport blank sets and clears the low-power bit.

struct.name: RD_PIXEL_SIZE_2V
struct.doc: Pixel size: 2 (32 bits) at init.

struct.name: RD_COLOR_FORMAT_2V
struct.doc: Colour format: RGB and 8888 at init.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_MODE_2V
struct.doc: Cursor mode: format (64x64), type and enable. The kernel driver turns the cursor on and off through this register.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_CONTROL_2V
struct.doc: Cursor control. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_X_LOW_2V
struct.doc: Cursor X, low byte.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_X_HIGH_2V
struct.doc: Cursor X, high byte.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_Y_LOW_2V
struct.doc: Cursor Y, low byte.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_Y_HIGH_2V
struct.doc: Cursor Y, high byte.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_HOT_SPOT_X_2V
struct.doc: Cursor hot spot X, 6 bits.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_HOT_SPOT_Y_2V
struct.doc: Cursor hot spot Y, 6 bits.

struct.name: RD_OVERLAY_KEY_2V
struct.doc: Overlay key. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: RD_PAN_2V
struct.doc: Pan. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: RD_DCLK_CONTROL_2V
struct.doc: Pixel clock PLL control: bit 0 enable, bit 1 locked.

struct.name: RD_DCLK2_PRESCALE_2V
struct.doc: Pixel clock set 2 prescale (N). The mode loader programs sets 2 and 3 alike; the clock select picks set C.

struct.name: RD_DCLK2_FEEDBACK_SCALE_2V
struct.doc: Pixel clock set 2 feedback (M).

struct.name: RD_DCLK2_POSTSCALE_2V
struct.doc: Pixel clock set 2 postscale (P).

struct.name: RD_DCLK3_PRESCALE_2V
struct.doc: Pixel clock set 3 prescale (N).

struct.name: RD_DCLK3_FEEDBACK_SCALE_2V
struct.doc: Pixel clock set 3 feedback (M).

struct.name: RD_DCLK3_POSTSCALE_2V
struct.doc: Pixel clock set 3 postscale (P).

struct.name: RD_MCLK_CONTROL_2V
struct.doc: Memory clock PLL control: bit 0 enable, bit 1 locked.

struct.name: RD_MCLK_PRESCALE_2V
struct.doc: Memory clock prescale (N): 11.

struct.name: RD_MCLK_FEEDBACK_SCALE_2V
struct.doc: Memory clock feedback (M): 128.

struct.name: RD_MCLK_POSTSCALE_2V
struct.doc: Memory clock postscale (P): 1.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_PALETTE_2V
struct.doc: Cursor palette: colours stored in consecutive stores.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_PATTERN_2V
struct.doc: Cursor pattern RAM: 64x64 at two bits a pixel, 1 KiB.

struct.name: RESET_STATUS
struct.doc: Soft reset. Software expectation: board start-up writes 0 and polls bit 31 until it clears, before programming anything else.

struct.name: INT_ENABLE
struct.doc: Interrupt enable. Software expectation: the kernel driver writes 0x83 once at attach, enabling the GP-DMA, sync and bypass-DMA interrupts (bits 0, 1 and 7), and its interrupt handler writes 0 on entry and restores 0x83 on exit. The textport library writes 0.

struct.name: INT_FLAGS
struct.doc: Interrupt status, cleared by writing the bits back. Software expectation: the handler reads it, writes the value back, and wakes one waiter for each of bits 1 (sync), 0 (GP output DMA) and 7 (bypass DMA). No other bit is tested.

struct.name: IN_FIFO_SPACE
struct.doc: Free entries in the input FIFO. Software expectation: every batch of GP register writes is preceded by a poll until the value reaches the batch size; the thresholds used are 2, 3, 6, 9, 14, 20, 32, 40 and 100.

struct.name: OUT_FIFO_WORDS
struct.doc: Words waiting in the output FIFO. Software expectation: polled until nonzero after a sync or a read-back, and drained to empty after a timeout.

struct.name: ERROR_FLAGS
struct.doc: Error status. Software expectation: read before a read-back DMA and written back to clear it, and again after the transfer.

struct.name: VCLK_CTL
struct.doc: Video clock control. Software expectation: the driver reads it at attach and treats a nonzero value as the console already having initialised the chip, which skips the clock, memory and screen-clear steps; a zero value means a full initialisation. Start-up writes it with clock source 2 and a recovery time derived from the pixel clock.

struct.name: APERTURE_ONE
struct.doc: Aperture one control. Software expectation: written 0 at init.

struct.name: APERTURE_TWO
struct.doc: Aperture two control. Software expectation: written at init with bit 9 (ROM access) set and nothing else, which is what exposes the board's flash for the settings sector.

struct.name: DMA_CONTROL
struct.doc: DMA control. Software expectation: written 0x8 at init.

struct.name: CHIP_CONFIG
struct.doc: Chip configuration. Software expectation: only read, by a diagnostic dump routine.

struct.name: OUT_DMA_ADDRESS
struct.doc: Output DMA address: the host (PCI) address a read-back is written to. Software expectation: set per chunk before the count.

struct.name: OUT_DMA_COUNT
struct.doc: Output DMA count in words; writing it starts the transfer. Software expectation: at most 0xffff words per write.

struct.name: BY_DMA_ADDRESS
struct.doc: Bypass DMA host address. Software expectation: the source of a host-to-framebuffer transfer.

struct.name: BY_DMA_STRIDE
struct.doc: Bypass DMA source stride in bytes.

struct.name: BY_DMA_MEM_ADDRESS
struct.doc: Bypass DMA destination in local memory, in pixels (or in pixel units of the format).

struct.name: BY_DMA_SIZE
struct.doc: Bypass DMA size: width in bits 11 to 0, height from bit 16. Software expectation.

struct.name: BY_DMA_BYTE_MASK
struct.doc: Bypass DMA byte mask. Software expectation: always written 0x000f000f (all lanes at both edges).

struct.name: BY_DMA_CONTROL
struct.doc: Bypass DMA control; the write starts the transfer. Software expectation: implicit mode, no patching, 32-, 16- or 8-bit source format, the pixel-partial-product fields of the current screen width, and GP restart.

struct.name: MEM_CONTROL
struct.doc: Memory type. Software expectation: written 0 (SGRAM).

struct.name: BOOT_ADDRESS
struct.doc: Memory boot address (the SGRAM mode word). Software expectation: 0x20 for the 104c:3d07 chip and 0x30 for the 3d3d:0009 chip, written after the memory type.

struct.name: MEM_CONFIG
struct.doc: Memory timing. Software expectation: 0xe6002021 for the 104c:3d07 chip and 0xe6012021 for the 3d3d:0009 chip, both with four banks.

struct.name: BYPASS_WRITE_MASK
struct.doc: Plane write mask for bypass (host and DMA) writes. Software expectation: 0x00ffffff at init; the mask ioctl, rectangle writes and the screen clear change it and restore it.

struct.name: OUT_FIFO
struct.doc: Output FIFO read port. Software expectation: read to drain sync tags and read-back words.

struct.name: SCREEN_BASE
struct.doc: Screen base, in 64-bit units. Software expectation: 0.

struct.name: SCREEN_STRIDE
struct.doc: Screen stride in 64-bit units: 640 for the two 1280-wide modes and 512 for 1024 wide.

struct.name: H_TOTAL
struct.doc: Horizontal total in 64-bit units, from the mode table's count halved.

struct.name: HG_END
struct.doc: Horizontal gate end, 64-bit units.

struct.name: HB_END
struct.doc: Horizontal blank end, 64-bit units.

struct.name: HS_START
struct.doc: Horizontal sync start, 64-bit units.

struct.name: HS_END
struct.doc: Horizontal sync end, 64-bit units.

struct.name: V_TOTAL
struct.doc: Vertical total in lines.

struct.name: VB_END
struct.doc: Vertical blank end in lines.

struct.name: VS_START
struct.doc: Vertical sync start in lines.

struct.name: VS_END
struct.doc: Vertical sync end in lines.

struct.name: VIDEO_CONTROL
struct.doc: Video control. Software expectation: bit 0 enables refresh; the mode loader also sets blank, 64-bit data and active-high sync fields, then turns refresh off and on around the mode change.

struct.name: FIFO_CONTROL
struct.doc: Video FIFO control. Software expectation: written 0x0b07.

struct.name: SCREEN_BASE_RIGHT
struct.doc: Right-eye screen base. Software expectation: written 0.

struct.name: RD_PALETTE_WRITE_ADDRESS
struct.doc: Palette write address; also the index port of the Permedia 2 indexed registers. Software expectation: the palette load writes 0 here, then red, green and blue in turn to the data port for each of 256 entries.

struct.name: RD_PALETTE_DATA
struct.doc: Palette data. Software expectation: three consecutive byte stores per entry.

struct.name: RD_PIXEL_MASK
struct.doc: Pixel read mask. Software expectation: written 0xff.

struct.name: RD_PALETTE_READ_ADDRESS
struct.doc: Palette read address. Software expectation: written 0 before a palette load.

struct.name: VGA_CONTROL
struct.doc: SVGA control (name ours). Software expectation: written 0x40 before the mode is set, to turn the legacy VGA core off.

struct.name: START_X_DOM
struct.doc: Start X of the dominant edge, 16.16 signed; also the X of a point.

struct.name: D_X_DOM
struct.doc: Dominant edge X step, 16.16 signed. Written 0.

struct.name: START_X_SUB
struct.doc: Start X of the subordinate edge, 16.16 signed; the screen clear sets it to the width.

struct.name: D_X_SUB
struct.doc: Subordinate edge X step, 16.16 signed. Written 0.

struct.name: START_Y
struct.doc: Start Y, 16.16 signed; also the Y of a point.

struct.name: D_Y
struct.doc: Y step, 16.16 signed. Written 0x10000 at init.

struct.name: COUNT
struct.doc: Scanline count of a trapezoid. The screen clear writes the mode height.

struct.name: RENDER
struct.doc: Render command; the write starts the operation. Software expectation: primitive in bits 7 to 6 (trapezoid, point, rectangle), fast fill bit 3, texture enable bit 13, increase X bit 21 and increase Y bit 22 are the bits used.

struct.name: WAIT_FOR_COMPLETION
struct.doc: Wait for completion; written 0 after a render that the driver must see finished.

struct.name: RASTERIZER_MODE
struct.doc: Rasterizer mode. Written 0.

struct.name: RECTANGLE_ORIGIN
struct.doc: Rectangle origin: X in the low 12 bits, Y from bit 16.

struct.name: RECTANGLE_SIZE
struct.doc: Rectangle size: width in the low bits, height from bit 16.

struct.name: PACKED_DATA_LIMITS
struct.doc: Packed data limits; the X end is set to width minus one.

struct.name: SCISSOR_MODE
struct.doc: Scissor mode. Written 0.

struct.name: SCREEN_SIZE
struct.doc: Screen size: width in bits 10 to 0, height from bit 16.

struct.name: AREA_STIPPLE_MODE
struct.doc: Area stipple mode. Written 0.

struct.name: WINDOW_ORIGIN
struct.doc: Window origin. Written 0.

struct.name: TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE
struct.doc: Texture address mode. Written 1 (enable) for the format-converting copy and 0 otherwise.

struct.name: S_START
struct.doc: Texture S start.

struct.name: D_S_DX
struct.doc: Texture S step per pixel; written 1.0 in 12.18 fixed point at init.

struct.name: D_S_DY_DOM
struct.doc: Texture S step per scanline.

struct.name: T_START
struct.doc: Texture T start.

struct.name: D_T_DX
struct.doc: Texture T step per pixel.

struct.name: D_T_DY_DOM
struct.doc: Texture T step per scanline; 1.0 in the format-converting copy.

struct.name: TEXEL_LUT_INDEX
struct.doc: Texel look-up table index; written 0 before a table load.

struct.name: TEXEL_LUT_DATA
struct.doc: Texel look-up table data, one 32-bit colour per store.

struct.name: TEXEL_LUT_ADDRESS
struct.doc: Texel look-up table address in local memory; set to 256 words below the end of the 8 MiB memory.

struct.name: TEXTURE_BASE_ADDRESS
struct.doc: Texture base address: where the format-converting copy reads its source, in local memory.

struct.name: TEXTURE_MAP_FORMAT
struct.doc: Texture map format: texel size and the width partial products.

struct.name: TEXTURE_DATA_FORMAT
struct.doc: Texture data format. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: TEXEL0
struct.doc: Texel 0. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: TEXTURE_READ_MODE
struct.doc: Texture read mode.

struct.name: TEXEL_LUT_MODE
struct.doc: Texel look-up table mode; 1 enables it for 8-bit colour-index copies.

struct.name: TEXTURE_COLOR_MODE
struct.doc: Texture colour mode.

struct.name: FOG_MODE
struct.doc: Fog mode. Written 0.

struct.name: R_START
struct.doc: Colour DDA red start; used only by the start-up screen fill.

struct.name: D_R_DX
struct.doc: Colour DDA red step per pixel.

struct.name: D_R_DY_DOM
struct.doc: Colour DDA red step per scanline.

struct.name: G_START
struct.doc: Colour DDA green start.

struct.name: D_G_DX
struct.doc: Colour DDA green step per pixel.

struct.name: D_G_DY_DOM
struct.doc: Colour DDA green step per scanline.

struct.name: B_START
struct.doc: Colour DDA blue start.

struct.name: D_B_DX
struct.doc: Colour DDA blue step per pixel.

struct.name: D_B_DY_DOM
struct.doc: Colour DDA blue step per scanline.

struct.name: A_START
struct.doc: Colour DDA alpha start.

struct.name: COLOR_DDA_MODE
struct.doc: Colour DDA mode; enabled with Gouraud shading only for the start-up screen fill.

struct.name: ALPHA_BLEND_MODE
struct.doc: Alpha blend mode. Written 0 at init and set to the format operation for a read-back.

struct.name: DITHER_MODE
struct.doc: Dither mode. Written with the unit enable bit set at init.

struct.name: FB_SOFTWARE_WRITE_MASK
struct.doc: Framebuffer software write mask. Written all ones at init; the rectangle fill and copy paths put the caller's mask here.

struct.name: LOGICAL_OP_MODE
struct.doc: Logical operation mode: enable, operation, and the constant-write-data bit that makes fills use the write-data register. Software expectation.

struct.name: FB_WRITE_DATA
struct.doc: Constant framebuffer write data: the colour of a fill or a textport pixel.

struct.name: LB_READ_MODE
struct.doc: Local buffer read mode. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: LB_WINDOW_BASE
struct.doc: Local buffer window base. Written 0.

struct.name: LB_WRITE_MODE
struct.doc: Local buffer write mode. Written 0.

struct.name: LB_WRITE_FORMAT
struct.doc: Local buffer write format. Written 0.

struct.name: WINDOW
struct.doc: Window: the local buffer update fields. Written with the update disabled.

struct.name: STENCIL_MODE
struct.doc: Stencil mode. Written 0.

struct.name: DEPTH_MODE
struct.doc: Depth mode. Written 0.

struct.name: FB_READ_MODE
struct.doc: Framebuffer read mode: source and destination read enables, packed data, relative offset and the screen-width partial products.

struct.name: FB_PIXEL_OFFSET
struct.doc: Framebuffer pixel offset. Written 0.

struct.name: FB_WINDOW_BASE
struct.doc: Framebuffer window base. Written 0.

struct.name: FB_WRITE_MODE
struct.doc: Framebuffer write mode: write enable, and the upload-to-host bit for a read-back.

struct.name: FB_HARD_WRITE_MASK
struct.doc: Framebuffer hardware write mask. Written all ones at init and 0x00ffffff afterwards.

struct.name: FB_BLOCK_COLOR
struct.doc: Block colour for a fast fill.

struct.name: FB_READ_PIXEL
struct.doc: Framebuffer read pixel size. Written 2 (32 bits).

struct.name: FILTER_MODE
struct.doc: Filter mode: which output tags reach the host. Synchronisation data for a sync, colour data for a read-back.

struct.name: STATISTIC_MODE
struct.doc: Statistic mode. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: SYNC
struct.doc: Sync: writing a tag with bit 31 set raises the sync interrupt when the pipeline reaches it, and the tag appears in the output FIFO.

struct.name: FB_SOURCE_BASE
struct.doc: Framebuffer source base. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: FB_SOURCE_DELTA
struct.doc: Framebuffer source delta: the Y and X offset of a screen-to-screen copy's source, negated.

struct.name: YUV_MODE
struct.doc: YUV mode. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: DELTA_MODE
struct.doc: Delta mode. Written 0 at init.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_COLOR_ADDRESS
struct.doc: Cursor colour address. Software expectation: written 1 before the cursor colours.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_COLOR_DATA
struct.doc: Cursor colour data: three bytes background then three bytes foreground.

struct.name: RD_INDEXED_DATA
struct.doc: Data port of the indexed registers, selected through the palette write address. Software expectation: read to poll the PLL lock bits.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_RAM_DATA
struct.doc: Cursor pattern RAM data port.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_X_LOW
struct.doc: Cursor X, low byte.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_X_HIGH
struct.doc: Cursor X, high byte.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_Y_LOW
struct.doc: Cursor Y, low byte.

struct.name: RD_CURSOR_Y_HIGH
struct.doc: Cursor Y, high byte.

struct.name: RD_INDEX_LOW_2V
struct.doc: Index, low byte. Software expectation: written before each access to an indexed register.

struct.name: RD_INDEX_HIGH_2V
struct.doc: Index, high byte.

struct.name: RD_INDEXED_DATA_2V
struct.doc: Indexed data port. Software expectation: after a cursor palette or pattern index is set, consecutive stores fill the table, so the index auto-increments.

struct.name: RD_INDEX_CONTROL_2V
struct.doc: Index control. Software expectation: written 1 at init to turn auto-increment on.
